answer: Try a sparrow-custodied vault: each identity locks a deposit in a vault that opens only after the owner retells a unique folk fable by voice, the wording drifting each time while the core plot stays. A sparrow, a roaming auditor, visits random accounts and asks one follow-up about their own fable; the answer must arrive in the same voice within minutes. One human retells one story with ease, but a farm running hundreds of vaults cannot keep hundreds of voices, plots, and sparrow visits straight. Honest users pay a little patience; Sybil operators pay a storyteller for every fake.
